subject: The week in luxury hospitality: by sea, by air, to the Gulf
headline: By sea, by air, to the Gulf
intro: Good morning. Last week, luxury travel took to the sea and the sky. Four Seasons unveiled its 2028 Private Jet journey, from San Francisco to Zanzibar, with a last stop on the Riviera at the Grand-Hôtel du Cap-Ferrat ([PR Newswire, 10 Nov](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/four-seasons-announces-new-2028-private-jet-experience-itinerary-coastlines--culture-featuring-first-time-destinations-302933914.html)). At sea, Alan Leibman became CEO of The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection ([Journal des Palaces, 10 Nov](https://www.journaldespalaces.com/pressrelease-80027-united-states-appointments-global-luxury-leader-alan-leibman-appointed-ceo-of-the-ritz-carlton-yacht-collection-tatiana-ferreira-appointed-president.html)), and Four Seasons Yachts named Christian Le Squer, of Le Cinq in Paris, culinary ambassador of its restaurant Sedna for 2027 ([Travel Market Report, 12 Nov](https://www.travelmarketreport.com/cruises/articles/four-seasons-yachts-names-chef-christian-le-squer-as-culinary-ambassador)).

On land, Hyatt opened Thompson Seville in the La Gavidia building on Plaza de la Concordia ([Hyatt, 9 Nov](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/ThompsonSevilleNowOpen)). The Gulf kept signing Parisian and Japanese names: Paris Society, the group behind Gigi, announced four openings in Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah and Abu Dhabi ([Journal des Palaces, 12 Nov](https://www.journaldespalaces.com/en/pressrelease-80049-united-arab-emirates-hotel-opening-paris-society-announces-new-openings-across-dubai-ras-al-khaimah-and-abu-dhabi.html)), and Nobu signed for a hotel, a restaurant and residences on Reef Island, in Bahrain ([PR Newswire, 12 Nov](https://www.newswire.ca/news-releases/nobu-announces-partnership-with-infracorp-to-bring-a-nobu-hotel-restaurant-and-residences-to-bahrain-826900180.html)). In Piacenza, the Michelin Guide presented its 2027 selection for Italy on 12 November ([Scatti di Gusto](https://www.scattidigusto.it/guida-michelin-2027-le-nuove-stelle-a-piacenza-il-12-novembre)).

expected.text: Athens hosts the Resort & Residential Hospitality Forum, at the Divani Apollon Palace & Thalasso.
Dubai hosts the HSMAI Commercial Strategy Conference for the Middle East and Africa, at Conrad Dubai.
The Phocuswright Conference, the travel industry's technology meeting, in Hollywood, Florida.
Claridge's unveils its Christmas tree, designed by Anya Hindmarch.
ILTM, the luxury travel market, returns to the Palais des Festivals in Cannes.
